notes: YC ships an Inertia.js JSON island in div[data-page]; the wrapper div id is a per-render UUID, so the recipe selects on the attribute, never the id.
posted_at is a humanized relative string ('about 12 hours'), not a timestamp — production would need to parse or ignore it.
Single company page: no pagination. A YC-wide crawl would be a different entrypoint.
